name: Westfield Promenade
description: Westfield Promenade is a premier shopping and entertainment destination in the Woodland Hills area of Los Angeles, featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment venues. This outdoor lifestyle center offers a modern shopping experience with convenient access from Topanga Canyon Boulevard. The center combines popular national retailers with local favorites in an inviting open-air environment.
summary: Westfield Promenade is a modern outdoor shopping and entertainment center in Woodland Hills offering diverse retail, dining, and entertainment options.
